required_attestation_limits.base: The receipt declares that a citation pack was assembled for the named editorial publication artifact. It does not establish article truth, evidence completeness, source authenticity, or that any citation mapping is correct. Machine-proposed mappings require operator admission before use.

notes: PROVISIONAL: This profile is not stable and has not been ratified. It remains provisional until at least two distinct corpus pipelines demonstrate reuse without modification.
requires_signing is false for v0.1 structural purposes. Production signing posture is deferred to the emitter implementation.
capture_manifest_ref is a SHOULD-level field; the structural validator does not enforce its presence.
Declared-only packs (where no source was captured) are fully valid under this profile.
All citation mappings are machine_proposed at the time of pack assembly; operator admission is outside the scope of this profile.
NON-ENFORCED: declaration_manifest_ref must match the corresponding ingest receipt; cross-receipt consistency cannot be verified from single-receipt structural validation.
NON-ENFORCED: Repository-snapshot provenance receipts must not be mixed with citation pack receipts; this is an emitter constraint not verifiable from receipt bytes alone.
